query: Death Valley Furnace Creek DEVC1 station highest daily maximum temperature recorded so far July 2026, actual observations July 7-13 2026
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the summary:

## Death Valley Furnace Creek (DEVC1) — Highest Daily Max, July 2026

**Highest daily maximum so far in July 2026 (through July 17): 121°F, recorded July 15, 2026.**

**For the July 7–13 window specifically**, the highest reading was **119°F**, hit on three consecutive days (July 9, 10, and 11).

Actual station observations (ACIS/NWS DEVC1), July 7–13:
- Jul 7: **117°F**
- Jul 8: **117°F**
- Jul 9: **119°F**
- Jul 10: **119°F**
- Jul 11: **119°F**
- Jul 12: 113°F
- Jul 13: 109°F

After a brief cooldown on July 12–13, heat re-intensified — July 15 reached the monthly peak of 121°F, followed by 120°F (Jul 16) and 117°F (Jul 17).

**Key sourcing note:** I used the ACIS/RCC StnData API keyed to station ID `DEVC1`, which serves the official NWS observations — the authoritative source. I cross-checked against Open-Meteo ERA5 reanalysis but flagged that it underreports Furnace Creek's sub-sea-level microclimate by ~6–9°F, so those gridded values (e.g., ~112°F for July 15) should not be used as the station reading. All values are observations, not forecasts.

key_facts: Highest daily maximum at DEVC1 (Furnace Creek) so far in July 2026 (through July 17): 121°F on July 15, 2026.
Within July 7–13, 2026, the highest daily max was 119°F, reached on July 9, 10, and 11 (three consecutive days).
Temperatures dipped to 109–113°F on July 12–13, then re-intensified to a monthly peak of 121°F on July 15, 120°F July 16, 117°F July 17.
All days July 1–17 2026 had highs at/above 107°F; crossed 110°F starting July 3.

For context, the all-time record at Furnace Creek is 134°F (July 10, 1913); modern verified extreme is 130°F (July 2021).
